task: Describe a time you were late for something important.
bullets: and how you felt about it
part3_questions: Why are some people often late?
Is punctuality more important in some cultures than others?
How has technology changed the way we manage time?

task: Describe a website or app that you find useful.
bullets: and explain why it is useful
part3_questions: What are the most popular apps in your country?
Do people rely too much on apps?
How might apps change in the future?

task: Describe an old object that your family has kept for a long time.
bullets: how long your family has had it
and why it is important to your family
part3_questions: Why do people keep old things?
Do young people value old objects?
Should old buildings be preserved?

task: Describe a time you received good news.
part3_questions: How do people usually share good news nowadays?
Is there too much bad news in the media?
Do people prefer to hear news from friends or the media?

task: Describe a person you know who is good at their job.
bullets: and why you think they are good at it
part3_questions: What makes someone successful at work?
Is job satisfaction more important than salary?
Should people stay in the same job for a long time?

task: Describe a city you would like to visit in the future.
bullets: and why you want to visit
part3_questions: Why do people like to visit big cities?
What problems does tourism cause in cities?
Will people travel more or less in the future?

task: Describe a sport or physical activity you enjoy.
part3_questions: Why do some people not exercise?
Should governments promote sport?
Are professional athletes good role models?

task: Describe a time you had to make a difficult decision.
bullets: and explain how you made the decision
part3_questions: What decisions do young people find difficult?
Should parents make decisions for their children?
Do people make better decisions alone or in groups?

task: Describe a film or TV series that made you think.
bullets: and why it made you think
part3_questions: Why are documentaries popular?
Do films influence people's behaviour?
Will cinemas disappear in the future?

task: Describe a time you learned something from a mistake.
part3_questions: Why are some people afraid of making mistakes?
Should schools punish students for mistakes?
Can people learn from other people's mistakes?

task: Describe a quiet place you like to go to.
part3_questions: Is it hard to find quiet places in cities?
Why do some people prefer noisy places?
How does noise affect people's health?

task: Describe a piece of clothing you like to wear.
part3_questions: Do people judge others by their clothes?
Why do fashions change so quickly?
Should students wear school uniforms?

task: Describe a conversation you had that changed your opinion.
part3_questions: Why is it difficult to change people's opinions?
Do social media make people more open-minded?
Is it important to listen to opposing views?

task: Describe an environmental problem in your area.
bullets: and what could be done about it
part3_questions: Who should be responsible for protecting the environment?
Are young people more environmentally aware than older people?
Can technology solve environmental problems?

task: Describe a time you saw something interesting on social media.
part3_questions: Why do things go viral online?
How can people tell if information online is true?
Should social media be regulated?

task: Describe a family member you spend a lot of time with.
bullets: and why you spend a lot of time with them
part3_questions: How have families changed in your country?
Should older people live with their children?
What role do grandparents play in family life?

task: Describe a time you tried a new food.
bullets: and whether you would eat it again
part3_questions: Why are people sometimes unwilling to try new food?
How has globalisation changed what people eat?
Should children be taught to cook at school?

task: Describe a public building you like.
part3_questions: Should governments spend money on beautiful public buildings?
How has architecture changed in your country?
Should old buildings be replaced by modern ones?

task: Describe something you did that made you feel proud.
part3_questions: Should parents praise their children a lot?
What achievements are valued in your society?
Is it better to work alone or in a team to achieve goals?

task: Describe a time when you had to wait for a long time.
part3_questions: Why are people less patient nowadays?
In what situations do people have to wait?
How could waiting times in public services be reduced?

task: Describe a skill you would like to learn in the future.
bullets: and why you want to learn it
part3_questions: Which skills will be most important in the future?
Is it better to learn from a teacher or by yourself?
Should employers pay for staff training?

task: Describe a time you lost something.
bullets: where and when you lost it
what you did to find it
part3_questions: Why do people lose things?
Is it a good idea to give a reward for lost items?
How can technology help people find lost things?

task: Describe an interesting talk or lecture you attended.
part3_questions: What makes a good public speaker?
Are online talks as effective as live ones?
Should students learn presentation skills at school?

task: Describe a time you enjoyed being outdoors.
part3_questions: Do children spend enough time outdoors?
What outdoor activities are popular in your country?
How do cities provide outdoor spaces?
